title: Help people jump right into your content

statement.en: Apply the documented Top Shelf guidance to help people jump right into your content.
statement.ja: 「Top Shelf」において「Help people jump right into your content」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Top Shelf experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるTop Shelfの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Apply the documented Top Shelf guidance to help people jump right into your content.” in the documented Top Shelf context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Apply the documented Top Shelf guidance to help people jump right into your content.

apple_native_rule: Apply the documented Top Shelf guidance to help people jump right into your content.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.
